findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the change and the alert, but does not prove the change caused the disruption.
ALR-0015 explicitly lists the start time 12:30 and the metrics for both sites.
The alarms were raised at 12:45, but cleared at 17:39 and 17:41, not 'around 17:40'.
CHG-2026-0042 confirms the ID, node, time, and description of the change.
T5 and T6 both show the dependency chain including LNK-SFX-02-A and AGG-SFX-02.
T4 explicitly reports no maintenance windows for the specified nodes and time window.
